INTERIOR WORK IN PROGRESS · CREW SHOWN AT SCALE

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK

Built by Susanna. Carried forward with Jenna.

Susanna Rivas built the painting practice from the ground up and brings a decade of professional experience. Jenna DuPlessis leads business operations and client communication.

Together, they are shaping Chromatic around quality, care, reliability, and the belief that color can completely change how a place feels.

Meet the studio

THE PRACTICAL PART

A beautiful result starts with a clear plan.

Every decision a serious client needs should be easy to find before the first walkthrough.

What painting services does Chromatic offer?
Chromatic offers interior painting, exterior painting, doors and trim, cabinet painting, stucco and drywall repair, wood, deck, and fence finishing, color consultation, office, retail, and restaurant painting, studio and fitness-space painting, commercial interiors and color blocking, commercial exterior repaints.
Are estimates free, and how quickly will Chromatic respond?
Painting estimates are free. Chromatic replies within 24 hours by call, text, or email.
How is the work protected and closed out?
Protection is selected for the property and work area, the crew sweeps and wipes down the space, and the agreed scope is reviewed during a final walkthrough.
What workmanship warranty is offered?
One year for peeling, blistering, or chipping caused by improper surface preparation or faulty application, subject to the written project terms.

YOUR PROJECT STARTS WITH THE SPACE

Show us what needs to change.

A location, a few photographs, the surface, and what the place needs to become are enough to begin.
